text:
marta: quick design review request on the Embeddings batch + Vector Inspector flow. i pushed a prototype here: https://figma.redwood/xyz :eyes:

marta: top goals — make it obvious what the export contains, reduce noise in the relevance table, and fix keyboard/accessibility for the preview modal.

alex: looked at the mock. main question: should export default to 'original input + vector + score' or 'vector only'? customers often want the original id/row to rejoin downstream.

marta: default to original id + vector + scores (JSONL) — but two-step: quick export (vectors only) and advanced export (include metadata + column selector). keeps UI simple.

jamal: +1 on two-step. tiny nit on column names in relevance table: currently "Score" vs "Relevance" swapped in visual. can we standardize to "Relevance (0-1)" and show tooltip: "Higher is better"?

alex: tooltip fine. also suggest showing rounded scores (3 dp) but full score on hover. reduces table width.

marta: will apply rounding. also debating whether to show vector dimension columns in preview — i think no, hide dims by default and show a small heatmap row or a compressed sparklines cell. any accessibility issues with sparklines?

sophia: sparklines are fine if we provide an aria-label and a textual fallback. screen readers need the min/max/mean as text. we should also ensure color contrast for the heatmap.

jamal: accessibility nit: modal close button needs descriptive label "Close vector preview" and focus trap must return focus to activating row. keyboard nav: support up/down to move rows, Enter to open preview, Esc to close.

marta: adding those to the PR. cc @ui-bot to run a11y checks once draft is up.

ui-bot: a11y check scheduled for 1769300300. issues found: insufficient contrast on heatmap palette (needs WCAG AA), missing aria-label on export dialog, and keyboard focus order on relevance table.

alex: thanks. for export copy — propose: Quick export: "Vectors (JSONL) — includes vector embeddings for selected rows". Advanced export dialog header: "Export vectors + metadata" with a short bulleted list of fields included and a sample.

marta: sample CSV/JSON snippet i'm proposing (for advanced export):

```
{ "id": "row-42", "text": "How do I reset my password?", "embedding": [0.0023, -0.134, ...], "relevance": 0.872 }
```

marta: any objections to including the first 5 columns preview in the dialog? it's handy for mapping.

jamal: love it. just call out that embeddings should be base64 optional in advanced (for smaller download sizes).

alex: +1 base64 optional toggle. also, can we add a tiny "preserve order" checkbox — some users expect identical row ordering after export.

marta: will add. final UX questions before i update figma: 1) Should the relevance table support inline filtering by score threshold? 2) Do we need a persistent "Export" button in the table header or only inside batch actions?

sophia: 1) yes, slider filter for threshold is powerful. provide keyboard increments. 2) keep a persistent export button in header (primary) and also per-row (secondary) in overflow menu.

alex: agree with sophia. small copy tweak: replace "Vectors" with "Embeddings" in any copy aimed at ML teams, but allow "Vectors (Embeddings)" for broader users.

marta: great, i'll update labels, tooling, and accessibility notes. i'll ping this channel when PR and figma link are ready. :thumbsup:
